segments.t: Chef Barinov returns to the kitchen sober—having actually gotten an anti-alcohol implant—and sincerely thanks Max. Moments later, the Chef overhears Max bragging about the staged video and chases him through the kitchen!
Вселенная опутана тонкими невидимыми нитями.
Они связывают нас с другими людьми.
Каждый поступок других людей изменяет нас.
Подумай о тех, кого ты изменишь.
Максим, подойди ко мне на минуту.
Да, шеф, я вас слушаю.
Прости меня за вчерашний день.
Спасибо, что не написал заявление.
Хорошо, шеф, всё уже позади.
Я же из-за тебя зашился!
Спокойно, шеф, только спокойно, прошу!
Я тебя убью, иди сюда!
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Вселенная опутана тонкими невидимыми нитями.
'The universe is wrapped in thin invisible threads.' Max brings out the contrast between 'universe' and 'entangled' in a few short words.
Они связывают нас с другими людьми.
'They connect us with other people.' Max anchors the line on 'they', while 'people' completes the thought.
Каждый поступок других людей изменяет нас.
'Every action of other people changes us.' The grammar packs 'every' and 'us' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Подумай о тех, кого ты изменишь.
'Think about those whom you will change.' The meaning hinges on 'think' working together with 'to cheat on' in spoken Russian.
Максим, подойди ко мне на минуту.
'Maxim, come over to me for a minute.' In Russian, the idea of 'approach' flows naturally into 'a minute' without extra filler words. Max answers right away.
Да, шеф, я вас слушаю.
'Yes, Chef, I am listening to you.' Max brings out the contrast between 'yes' and 'I' in a few short words.
Прости меня за вчерашний день.
'Forgive me for yesterday.' Notice how Russian expresses 'forgive' and 'day' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
Спасибо, что не написал заявление.
'Thank you for not filing a police report.' The meaning hinges on 'thank you' working together with 'statement' in spoken Russian. Max answers right away.
Хорошо, шеф, всё уже позади.
'Alright, Chef, it is all behind us now.' Max brings out the contrast between 'well' and 'everything' in a few short words.
Я же из-за тебя зашился!
'I got a sobriety implant because of you!' Notice the reflexive suffix on the verb meaning 'got an anti-alcohol implant', turning the action back on the subject.
Спокойно, шеф, только спокойно, прошу!
'Easy, Chef, just take it easy, please!' Notice how Russian expresses 'calmly' and 'ask for' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Barinov answers right away.
Я тебя убью, иди сюда!
'I will kill you, get over here!' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'here' in spoken Russian. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.

And that brings Episode 9 of Season 3 to a hilarious close! Chef Barinov is sober against his will, Kostya is honest with Nastya, and Katya's Parisian secret is ticking. See you in Episode 10!
